answer: Consider Endorsed racing cyclist licence with cycling federation attestation as the gate. With a licence the federation renews after race audits in place, the marble an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. Time is the tax here: a licence the federation renews after race audits cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the canyon for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of. The sonnet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
